text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a bicycle. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates multiple objects within a single image. These technologies have many practical applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise traffic signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Computer vision is also used in medical imaging, security systems, and face recognition on smartphones. As technology improves, computers will become even better at seeing and understanding the world around them.
